header.running_head: The Lectures Rasulullaah ﷺ Delivered on the Occasion of Hajj

blocks.text: Hadhrat Abu Umaamah (RA) also reports that Rasulullaah ﷺ was on a camel called Jad'aa with his feet in the stirrups and standing high so that people could hear him. Rasulullaah ﷺ then said at the top of his voice, "Can you not hear?" "O Rasulullaah ﷺ!" someone from the gathering asked, "What is it that you wish to advise us?" Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "Worship your Rabb, perform your five Fardh salaahs, fast for your month (of Ramadhaan), obey your leader and you will enter the Jannah of your Rabb."[^1]

blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan bin Mu'aadh Taymi (RA)
blocks.text: Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan bin Mu'aadh Taymi (RA) relates, "We were at Mina when Rasulullaah ﷺ addressed us. We listened attentively and could therefore hear him clearly even though we were in our camps. Rasulullaah ﷺ started teaching the people the rites of Hajj. When Rasulullaah ﷺ reached the Jamaraat, he placed both fingers in his ears and announced that only small pebbles be used to pelt. Thereafter, he instructed the Muhaajireen to camp at the front of the Masjid (Khayf) and the Ansaar to camp at the rear. The rest of the people then set up their own camps."[^2]

Hadhrat Raafi bin Amr Muzani (RA) narrates that it was in Mina during midmorning when he saw Rasulullaah ﷺ deliver a sermon on a brown mule. Hadhrat Ali (RA) was amplifying what Rasulullaah ﷺ said and while some people were standing, others were sitting.[^3]

Hadhrat Abu Hurra Raqaashi reports from his uncle (RA) who was holding the reins of Rasulullaah ﷺ's camel during the middle days of the days of Tashreeq. As he was busy warding the people away from Rasulullaah ﷺ, Rasulullaah ﷺ was addressing the people saying, "O people! Do you know in which month you are? Do you know in which day you are? Do you know in which city you are?" The Sahabah (RA) replied, "We are in a sacred day, a sacred month and a sacred city." Rasulullaah ﷺ then said, "Now remember that until the day you meet Allaah, your blood, your wealth and your honour are as sacred to you as the sacredness of this day in this month and in this city."
Rasulullaah ﷺ said further, "Listen attentively to what I say and you will live well. Behold! Never oppress! Behold! Never oppress! Behold! Never oppress! The wealth of a Muslim is not permissible without his consent. Take note that all blood money, other monies and prejudices that took place during the Period of Ignorance are now trampled beneath my two feet until the Day of Qiyaamah. The first blood money that I wish to waive is that of the son of Rabee'ah bin Haarith whom the Hudhayl tribe killed while he was still a suckling infant with the Banu Layth tribe. Also take note that all the interest due during the Period of Ignorance is also waived and the first that I wish to waive is that which was due to Abbaas bin Abdul Muttalib. Creditors can have back only the amounts they lent (and no interest). Do not oppress and you will not be oppressed. Take note of the fact that time has revolved to return to the way it had been when Allaah created the
